item.title: pi-claude-bridge: your Claude Pro, Max or Team subscription inside pi
item.description: pi-claude-bridge wires pi to the Claude Code Agent SDK so you can use Opus, Sonnet and Haiku from your Pro, Max or Team subscription as regular pi models, with no API key and every tool call flowing through pi's TUI.
item.dc:creator: Pablo Caro

item.title: pi-provider-opencode-console: live OpenCode Go models without waiting for pi releases
item.description: pi-provider-opencode-console adds OpenCode Console and OpenCode Go to pi with OAuth device-code login and a live model catalog, so you no longer wait for a pi release to refresh its static model list.
item.dc:creator: Pablo Caro

item.title: aa-opencode: OpenCode models with benchmarks and price in one table
item.description: aa-opencode crosses the OpenCode model catalog with Artificial Analysis benchmarks and prints one table with intelligence, speed, and price per model. A Python CLI I just published.
item.dc:creator: Pablo Caro

item.title: qemu-wasm: full virtual machines inside your browser
item.description: qemu-wasm ports QEMU to WebAssembly to boot a full x86_64 virtual machine inside the browser. trynix.dev runs any nixpkgs package from the last 13 years, and a GitHub Action boots a PR's build from a single link.
item.dc:creator: Pablo Caro

item.title: ku: navigate Kubernetes from the terminal like a pro
item.description: ku is a fast, keyboard-driven Kubernetes TUI inspired by k9s and lazygit. Read-only by default, with a cluster cockpit, logs, pod shells, port-forwarding, and object editing.
item.dc:creator: Pablo Caro

item.title: AgentsView: local analytics for your coding agents
item.description: AgentsView is an open-source tool that indexes sessions from 20+ coding agents into a local SQLite database, providing analytics dashboards, cost tracking, and full-text search without sending data off your machine.
item.dc:creator: Pablo Caro

item.title: Detecting secrets in git with gitleaks
item.description: gitleaks scans git repositories for secrets, API keys, and leaked credentials. Install it in seconds with gah — it might save you from a very bad day.
item.dc:creator: Pablo Caro

item.title: Cleaning up npx's hidden cache
item.description: npx leaves a hidden package cache in ~/.npm/_npx/. Here's how to list what you've accumulated and clean it up.
item.dc:creator: Pablo Caro
